label: Architecture Decision Record Writer
description: Creates well-structured Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) from technical discussions. Documents context, decision, consequences, and alternatives considered in standard format.

guidedInputs.label: Decision title
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Use PostgreSQL instead of MongoDB, Adopt event-driven architecture for order processing, Introduce API gateway for microservices

guidedInputs.label: Problem and context
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe the technical challenge, constraint, or opportunity that required a decision. What was the situation? What forces were at play? What were the non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, maintainability, cost)?

guidedInputs.label: Decision made (or proposed)
guidedInputs.placeholder: What was decided? Be specific. Include the key technical choice and any important constraints or conditions on the decision.

guidedInputs.label: Alternatives considered
guidedInputs.placeholder: List the other options that were evaluated. For each, note key advantages and why it was not chosen.

guidedInputs.label: Known consequences
guidedInputs.placeholder: What are the positive and negative consequences of this decision? What tradeoffs are we accepting? What new problems does this create? What does this simplify?

guidedInputs.label: Decision makers
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Engineering team, CTO, Architecture review board
